system.description:
At the master's call the flames answer in a searing wash, raining sheets of fire across an entire room to burn everything within.

Target any spot you can see within 50 feet, filling an area up to 20 feet across with roaring flame. Make a mass challenge of your Mental Traits against the Physical Traits of everyone within; anyone who loses immediately takes one level of aggravated damage, and victims who cannot reasonably escape may be burned automatically at the Narrator's option. All flammable materials ignite at once. The Firestorm lasts until you stop it, move out of range, or are knocked unconscious, sent to torpor or destroyed, and anyone remaining in the area suffers one aggravated level at the end of every turn. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until you end it or move out of range
